metaTitle: Custom Full Color Eyewear Accessories | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color eyewear accessories for your team. Perfect Imprints offers vibrant decoration on lanyards, glasses cases, and more.
introHtml: Full color decoration on eyewear accessories gives your brand a vivid, photographic look that standard one- or two-color imprints can't match. Whether you're outfitting a trade show team with custom lanyards or providing branded cleaning cloths for a product launch, the full color process reproduces logos, gradients, and detailed artwork with sharp clarity. Choose from polyester lanyards, microfiber pouches, or retractable badge reels—all decorated in rich CMYK for maximum visual impact.
heroAltText: Custom full color eyewear accessories including branded lanyards and glasses cases with vibrant logo decoration
